_what: RAW SUBPROCESS KILLS ON A CLOCK that this tree already carried when watchdog_ceiling_semantics_check gained its class-(0) raw-kill shape. A RATCHET BY MEMBERSHIP: it may only ever SHRINK. Nothing here is blessed and nothing here is exempt -- every entry is printed on every run with its remedy, and any site NOT in this file is refused with rc 1.
_why_not_just_fixed: Each of these is a live production launch in a program this lane does not own, and converting one is a behaviour change that needs its own both-directions proof. The gate's own RESIDUAL_CONTAINER_CLOCK class already sets this precedent in this file: report by name rather than refuse, because a silent clean verdict would say the work was done.
_the_remedy_for_every_entry: Route the launch through `_progress_run.run` -- it is a drop-in for `subprocess.run(..., timeout=N)`, converted by DELETING the `timeout=` argument -- and report `_progress_run.Stalled` by name. The supervisor stops a child only when captured output, the process tree's CPU and its block I/O were ALL flat for a count of consecutive looks.
